shortBio.en: Judas Priest vocalist; operatic highs and leather-studs metal frontman image.
shortBio.zh: Judas Priest 主唱；歌剧式高音与皮衣铆钉金属主唱形象。

body.en:
Born 1951. Joins early 70s. British Steel through Painkiller define metal vocal range + motorcycle stage entry. Leaves 1992; returns 2003.

Voice is the brand constant beside twin guitars.
body.zh:
1951 年生。70 年代初加入。British Steel 至 Painkiller 定义金属音域 + 摩托车上场。1992 离队；2003 回归。

人声是双吉他旁的品牌常量。

whyHub.en: Halford → Ripper Owens → Halford return: singer swap without killing twin-guitar DNA.
whyHub.zh: Halford → Ripper Owens → Halford 回归：换主唱而不杀双吉他 DNA。
